②are: 'The real clash is actually are between stories' → 주어 The real clash(단수)에 is가 필요. are는 복수형이라 틀림. ①rarely, ③experienced, ④ideology는 적절.

②understanding: 'form narratives to help us understanding the world' → help+목적어+원형이므로 understand가 필요. understanding은 진행형/동명사라 틀림. ①challenger, ③particular, ④unfortunate는 적절.
④superficially: 'become superficially rooted in our identity' → 원문은 deeply(깊이). superficially(표면적으로)는 반대. ①dominate, ②encounter, ③unfortunate는 적절.
③fortunate: 'on just a few fortunate occasions' → 원문은 unfortunate(불행한). fortunate(행운의)는 반대. ①dominate, ②battle, ④ideology는 적절.
②nonsense: 'seek to make nonsense of them by forming stories' → 원문은 sense(make sense of=이해하다). nonsense(무의미)는 반대. ①memorability, ③shape, ④ideology는 적절.
④geography: 'related with your political geography' → 원문은 ideology(이념). geography(지리)는 부적합. ①persuasiveness, ②incumbent, ③judge는 적절.
'we ____ form narratives to help us understand the world' → 습관적으로 내러티브를 형성한다는 맥락. routinely(③=습관적으로). occasionally(가끔), reluctantly(마지못해), accidentally(우연히)는 부적합.
'the ____ you have formed around gun control or climate change' → 총기 규제 등에 대해 형성한 것. narrative(④=내러티브, 이야기). assumption(가정), regulation(규제), institution(기관)은 부적합.
'our minds seek to ____' — 다양한 사실에 마주쳤을 때 마음이 하는 것. 'make sense of them by forming stories around them'(③)이 원문. avoid them(①), classify them(②), reject them(④)는 부적합.
